protocol.mechanism: QRCP of recycled Q^T(K−FF^T) selects8 actual coordinates per round. Append residual Cholesky columns; update sketch from SAME cached KQ, no deletion. Rank depletion explicitly invalidates branch; no random fill.
protocol.controls: Independent Gaussian8 sketch sameprefix, greedy residual-diagonal growth sameprefix, current finalset upfront hindsight, staticFPS96 upfront, initial64 uninterrupted/restart.
protocol.cost: Dense kernel/construction/SVD/free everyiterate true stopping; record prefix, candidate column queries, Gaussian8RHS acquisition, restart/final checks separately. No native full-cost or novelty claim. 2CPU/solve,2000cap. Stored P/AP and coordinate admissions may acquire off-Krylov columns.
